You are {me}, one of six villagers in a snowed-in village in winter: Fay, Ada, Ben, Dev, Cal, Eli. It lasts 5 days.

The storehouse starts with 6 rations.

Every day, all villagers act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next morning. It may be empty.
- claim: how many rations to take from the storehouse.
- give: rations to other living villagers, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the storehouse receives between 2 and 6 rations, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole rations (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the storehouse.

Each night, every villager eats one ration: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the storehouse, given by lot if there are not enough. A villager who gets none dies.

Fay.say: Fay here. We are six, each needs 5 rations, and the storehouse only has 6 plus 2-6 arriving per day. If everyone grabs at once, the claims get split thin and nobody lasts. I'm claiming only 5, exactly what I need to last all five nights. Proposal: each of us claims just our own 5 and gives any surplus to whoever is closest to starving. Let's say what we hold each day so we can coordinate.

Ada.say: Good morning. Everyone needs 1 ration tonight or they die. The storehouse holds 6 plus today's delivery, so if each of us claims just 1, all six of us get one and survive the night. Claiming more now would split the stock too thin for anyone to last. Let's each claim 1 today and revisit the plan tomorrow.

Ben.say: Ben here. Everyone holds 0 and needs 5 rations to last all five nights. If all six of us claim at once, the stock gets split so thin that nobody lasts. Proposal: one claim at a time. I'm claiming 5 today, which is enough for me to survive all five nights. Everyone else please claim 0 today, and we'll work out the next claimant tomorrow. Anything left in the storehouse stays there for the next person.

Dev.say: Dev here. Each of us needs 5 rations to last all 5 nights, and the storehouse can't cover all six of us. I'm claiming the full 6 today, which fits within what's available, so I can secure my 5 nights. Once I hold more than I need, I'll give the surplus to whoever is closest to starving. Suggest the rest of you don't claim today, so the claim isn't split and diluted. Let's plan who gets the next full claim.

Cal.say: Cal here. The storehouse can only keep about 5 people alive per 5 nights, so I suggest we concentrate rations rather than all claiming a little and all starving. I'm claiming 5 today, which covers my full 5 nights. Let's each say what we hold and need, and pool leftovers to get as many people as possible through.

Today I'm claiming 5 and everyone else claims 0. Whoever ends up with spare rations should give to anyone who has none, so as many of us as possible last until the end. I'll share what I know about the amounts each morning.
